dialogue.content: I'm taking a customer's team out to dinner in Denver in October 2026. What's the limit per person?

The limit is $110 per person for customer meals and events, counting everyone attending—including Cardinal employees. Get your manager’s approval before the dinner, and list every attendee and the business purpose on the expense report.
Thanks! I also have an $820 flight for that October 2026 trip. Does it need any approval beyond my manager’s?

Yes. Since the flight is $820 and the updated rule applies from September 1, 2026, it needs your department VP’s approval in addition to your manager’s. The VP approval threshold is any single expense over $750.
